description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS application demonstrating task watchdog functionality, including initialization, callback handling, and thread management.

methods.name: task_wdt_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked by the task watchdog channel, performs system reboot.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing watchdog, adding a watchdog channel, and periodically feeding it.

methods.name: control_thread
methods.description: High-priority thread that adds a watchdog channel with a custom callback and simulates a stuck condition.
